levels.name: Essential
levels.description: Cannot ship without: runtime failures, the deployment blockers of both Microsoft cops, compiler future errors, PlatformCop.

levels.name: Recommended
levels.description: Every default-on rule at its author severity; marketplace checks join here.

levels.name: Strict
levels.description: Recommended with advisory rules promoted to Warning.

stages.name: default
stages.description: Editor and any consumer without its own stage. The level result as is.

stages.name: CI
stages.description: Pull request and release builds. Postponable diagnostics relaxed to Info.

stages.name: vNext
stages.description: Builds against the next platform. Future errors at Error, obsolete-pending at Warning.
